title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP programme will be implemented in the Centre North region of Burkina Faso and will target 2,265 households, comprising both Internally Displaced households and vulnerable households in host communities. 22,650 beneficiaries will be supported. Farmers will be trained in climate smart crop production, agro-forestry and environmentally friendly market gardening. The focus will be on facilitating households to increase food production while restoring and protecting the natural environment and natural resources. Degraded land will be restored, natural regeneration methods applied, and trees planted. (The programme will support the planting of 10,000 trees). Communities will be trained in restoration of degraded land, in techniques for soil and water conservation and water committees will be established. The programme will also support engagement in small scale, integrated livestock farming such as rearing of goats, poultry and fish farming.Boreholes will be drilled and irrigation systems established for market gardening activities.Women will be organised into Market Garden Management Committees, trained in food production, nutrition, hygiene and sanitation and will raise awareness of these issues at community level.Training and support will be provided to IDPs for vegetable gardening and livestock farming for both food consumption and income generation. In addition, IDPs will be selected for vocationaltraining in skills such as masonry, tiling, hairdressing and sewing and support provided for the start-up of businesses. The programme will contribute to the growth of green enterprise.Specifically, it will support the manufacture and use of energy efficient stoves and will promote the use of alternative sources of fuel such as woodlots and solar power.Objectives:'[CRS format 2024 MC Other.xlsx]SHA DAC Edit'!$1:$635Outcmes: Outcome 2: Equitable and inclusive food systems to support availability, access and consumption of safe nutritious food
